INFRARED SAUNA LEDS

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

  • Wouldn’t it be great if you can have the peace of mind that your supplier will always be around to supply you the things you need for your infrared sauna?
  • How many times you have to find a new supplier because your previous one went out of business?
  • Read on to learn more about one supplier that has been in the business long enough to understand your situation.

InfraredSaunaParts was established in 2001 and ever since has been supplying many infrared saunas with parts and appliances. At InfraredSaunaParts, we not only supply locally, but we also supply infrared sauna parts to sauna in other countries. We have many satisfied customers who became our most loyal customers because we’re able to get them everything and anything that they need for their infrared sauna.

We understand how frustrating it is to learn that your supplier is not able to supply you with the things you need or even worse, closed down due to any reason. At InfraredSaunaParts, we have goods that can satisfy your every need, be it from accessories to electrical appliances. And we also have items that are considered “outdated” by many modern suppliers.

Many of our customers come to us for items that were manufactured some 10 – 15 years ago and they were delighted that we’re able to supply these good to them. Many things such as sauna fans, fuses, and lamps are among the common items that our customers prefer to have the same brand they have been using.

At InfraredSaunaParts, we have various types of fans, fuses, and lamps. Our lamps selection ranges from shades to housing to light assembly. We know how important it is to have the right lighting effect in your sauna to create a relaxing and calming ambiance. This is why we take pride in our lamps selection so we’re able to meet our customers’ needs.

Why not take your time to browse through our catalogue to find for the things you need and also to see what else we have to offer. And after that, why not call the number below to talk to us about how we can help to your business thrive?
